title: PersonaCodeBench: Evaluating Coding Agents in Persona-driven Human-Interactive Sessions
abstract: arXiv:2611.05739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents must deliver correct software while respecting users' expertise, preferences, and working conditions. Existing benchmarks increasingly incorporate interaction, yet personalized requirement fulfillment remains underexplored. We introduce PersonaCodeBench, which turns user characteristics into verifiable obligations in persona-driven multi-turn coding sessions. Our persona pool spans roles, technical abilities, interaction preferences, and practical constraints, yielding task-grounded evolved requirements for implementation, permissions, testing, explanation, and delivery. At runtime, a controller governs user simulator responses and requirement disclosure, using online requirement evaluation to provide feedback and advance the interaction. Requirements emerge progressively, with their content, disclosure conditions, and acceptance criteria fixed before evaluation. A completion verifier and a personalization verifier separate

translated_title: PersonaCodeBench：在人格驱动的人机交互会话中评估编码智能体
translated_abstract: 编码智能体必须在交付正确软件的同时尊重用户的专业水平、偏好和工作条件。现有基准测试日益纳入交互环节，但个性化需求的满足仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了 PersonaCodeBench，它在人格驱动的多轮编码会话中将用户特征转化为可验证的义务。我们的人格库涵盖角色、技术能力、交互偏好和实际约束，从而产生基于任务且逐步演化的需求，涵盖实现、权限、测试、解释和交付等方面。在运行时，控制器管理用户模拟器的响应与需求披露，利用在线需求评估提供反馈并推进交互。需求逐步浮现，其内容、披露条件和验收标准在评估前即已固定。完成验证器与个性化验证器分别（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 PersonaCodeBench 基准，通过将用户人格特征转化为多轮编码会话中可验证的义务，评估编码智能体在满足个性化需求方面的能力。
en_tdlr: PersonaCodeBench evaluates coding agents' ability to fulfill personalized requirements by converting user personas into verifiable obligations in persona-driven multi-turn interactive coding sessions.
